strata_selection.note: one unstratified sample across every rating

criterion: a program is selected if it catches >= 0.67 of the scoreable natural mutants caught; the corpus is frozen only if >= 270/360 programs passing
usability_criterion: test data present; reference passes its own cases; the faulty version is refuted by the shipped pool; neither version times out
selection: at most one fault per coding task; the gate is measured on the first 360 stage-1 survivors (360 passed), and the corpus is topped up past that cohort until 360 passing programs are held
